title: Zesty Korean Prawns Toast
description: A peppery and chewy Korean dish featuring raw tiger prawns on toast, made in an iron teppan and suitable for a Jain-friendly diet. This festive dish is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan to medium-high heat.
Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Brush the toasted bread slices with sesame oil and season with black pepper.
Arrange the toasted bread slices on the preheated iron teppan.
Place a raw tiger prawn on each bread slice.
Drizzle the gochujang sauce over the prawns.
Garnish with thinly sliced green onions.
Be careful when handling the hot iron teppan.
Make sure to cook the prawns to an internal temperature of at least 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
